description: Upload a receipt sent inline as base64 (e.g. an e-mail attachment) to sevDesk's temporary voucher storage — for hosted clients that cannot use sevdesk_upload_voucher_file's local path. Returns fileName, the token sevdesk_create_voucher attaches to a new voucher. PDF, PNG, JPG and XML (XRechnung / ZUGFeRD e-invoice) only, checked by content and not only the name, at most 10 MB. Accepts standard and URL-safe base64 and data: URLs. Creates no voucher by itself. ⚠️ This tool can change data in sevDesk.

dryRun.description: Check the file without uploading it.

fileName.description: Original file name with extension .pdf, .png, .jpg, .jpeg or .xml.

name: sevdesk_upload_voucher_file_content
title: Upload a receipt file (inline)
